exposure: Site of placental implantation (cornual-fundal region, placenta praevia)
cohort: The study enrolled 300 women, consisting of 100 women with breech presentation and 200 women with cephalic presentation (control group).
finding: Placenta was found in the cornual-fundal site in 70% of breech presentation cases compared to 10% of cephalic presentation cases, suggesting site of placental implantation could impact fetal presentation.
